notes_for_editor: Thin record and the story is below the 120-word floor (about 70 words) because the evidence does not support more. The Forest Lookouts page gives only a name, county and agency. A Texas A&M Forest Service history record (edocs.tamu.edu, document id 1910, titled as a Bon Wier Lookout Tower history) appeared in search results with a title that suggests the original wooden tower was replaced by a steel one in 1958. That document is behind a WebLink sign-in; the cached copy is a sign-in error page, so nothing from it is used here and no evidence entry depends on it. An editor with access should read it before this story is published or extended. The tnlandforms list has an unlabelled numeric column that could not be interpreted, so it is used only for the name and point. The brief's status 'gone' is supported only by the FFLA list.
